scenarios.description: getPayment_id() returns 0 on a newly constructed PaymentHistory object before any setter is called.
getPayment_id() returns X after setPayment_id(X) is called with a positive value.
getPayment_id() returns -1 after setPayment_id(-1) is called.
getPayment_id() returns Integer.MAX_VALUE after setPayment_id(Integer.MAX_VALUE) is called.
getPayment_id() returns Integer.MIN_VALUE after setPayment_id(Integer.MIN_VALUE) is called.
getPayment_id() returns the most recently set value after multiple calls to setPayment_id with different values.
getPayment_id() returns 42 after setPayment_id(42) is called.
getPayment_id() returns zero after setPayment_id(0) is called.
getPayment_id() returns the latest value after setPayment_id is called repeatedly with the same value.
getPayment_id() returns the value loaded from persistence layer when a PaymentHistory entity is hydrated by JPA with a payment_id value.
getPayment_id() returns the most recently set value when setPayment_id() is called multiple times with different integers.
getPayment_id() returns 0 after setPayment_id(0) is called on a Payment object.
getPayment_id() does not alter the state of any other Payment fields when called.
getPayment_id() returns correct value after setting payment_id via setPayment_id() followed by modifying other unrelated fields.
